faq.q: How much does it cost?
faq.a: $29.99 a month, or $299.99 a year — that works out to $24.99 a month. Every feature is included.

faq.q: Do I need a credit card for the free trial?
faq.a: No. Try everything free for 30 days and cancel any time.

faq.q: Can it connect to my bank and POS?
faq.a: Yes. Connect your bank card and your POS system and transactions sync in automatically. You review them and Meksova puts them in the right category. You can always add entries by hand too.

faq.q: I'm not good with accounting. Will I manage?
faq.a: Yes. You tap Received, Paid or Owed and pick a category. Meksova does the debits, credits and reports for you.

about.metaDescription: Meksova is a Columbus, Ohio company building simple, multilingual bookkeeping for immigrant-owned and small businesses.
about.title: Built by owners who were
about.lede: We ran our own small businesses and struggled to keep our books straight. So we built the tool we wished we had — simple, honest, and in the languages our community speaks.
story: Most bookkeeping software is built for accountants. It's in English, full of jargon, and assumes you already know what a journal entry is.

Meksova starts from the other side. You tell it what happened — money came in, money went out, or you owe something — and it does the accounting behind the scenes: journal, income statement, balance sheet and estimated tax.
Every setup comes ready for a real trade, from trucking and IFTA to grocery stock and cost of goods, and the whole app speaks seven languages.
